title: An explanation before the practice
description: A short answer to a specific question tied to the session coming up.

blocks.text: A beginner is often unclear what is expected of them and how to treat being distracted. The name of a meditation alone is not enough to choose by.

quote.text: Waking Up is the rare meditation app that treats you like an adult. No soft-focus clichés, no mystical promises, no “just breathe and manifest” fluff. It’s built for people who want clarity, not incense; insight, not slogans.

blocks.text: Tie every explanation to an exercise and let people switch between them. Keep a description of the approach, the author’s opinion and testable claims apart.
Do not overload the beginning with a lecture. An explanation should help take the next step; promises of an effect require separate grounds.
